 Slightly cooler Wednesday with dry conditions prevailing 
 A few mountain showers by the weekend 
 Southern Colorado continues its mild and dry pattern into Wednesday and the rest of the week. By Josephine Saige Published : Nov. 10, 2026 at 5:10 PM MST | Updated : 32 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Still dry and mild 
 Slight cool down for Wednesday 
 Weekend mountain moisture possible 
 TUESDAY NIGHT: Temperatures stay mild with overnight lows in the low 30s for most, that’s still about 5 degrees above averages. Some clouds will stick around overnight too.
 WEDNESDAY: After a weak front passes, southern Colorado will drop into the upper 50s and low 60s, but that means we are still above averages. More sunshine is expected for Wednesday afternoon with a light breeze as well.
 THURSDAY AND FRIDAY: Very table temperatures are expected across southern Colorado to wrap up the work week. 50s and 60s will prevail with minimal change as sun and dry conditions stick around.
 THE WEEKEND: The mountains may see a few showers though the weekend days while southern Colorado likely stays dry. A loose shower may be possible for Colorado Springs and Pueblo on Sunday. Temperatures will begin to cool by Sunday as well.

 EARLY NEXT WEEK: For now, southern Colorado is trending cool and still dry into early next week. The higher elevations look at bit wetter. By the middle to the end of next week is when changes look to be more favorable.
